aurora.description: Aurora is the Steam client without the bloat. The official app runs a whole web browser in the background just to show your games. Aurora throws that out and draws everything natively, so it opens in a blink and barely touches your RAM. Store, Library, Downloads, Friends & Chat, Workshop and Inventory are all still there, along with a Big Picture mode for the couch and custom themes to make it yours. Curious? Run aurora --demo to look around without signing in.
